narrative.overview:
Institutional Clarity turns a large administrative health dataset into a calm, authoritative instrument for territorial consultation. A deep-blue shell establishes public-sector confidence, while white analytical surfaces, fine dividers, compact Inter typography, and controlled cyan affordances keep attention on facts rather than decoration.

The system is deliberately dense but never cramped: hierarchy comes from continuous rails, aligned grids, restrained tonal layers, and strongly differentiated labels, metrics, and prose. Its character is precise, transparent, and operational; the same facility identity travels consistently from filters and tables to the municipal map and printable technical sheet.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-navy institutional chrome around white analytical work surfaces.
Functional cyan reserved for actions, focus, active states, and quantitative emphasis.
Compact Inter hierarchy with tracked uppercase labels and tabular numerals.
Divider-led depth, softly precise corners, and almost no ambient shadow.
Dense desktop grids that become stacked, touch-ready records on small screens.

rules.name: The Cyan Means Action Rule
rules.body: Functional cyan and action blue identify interaction, focus, active state, or meaningful quantitative emphasis; they are not broad decorative fills.

rules.name: The Classification Is Semantic Rule
rules.body: Facility colors never change by page or chart: blue is Hospital, terracotta is UPA, violet is UPAE, and teal is UPAE-R.

rules.name: The Administrative Scan Rule
rules.body: Labels are small, uppercase, tracked, and heavy; values remain mixed case and larger so a user can separate category from fact at a glance.

rules.name: The Numbers Align Rule
rules.body: Counts, currency, beds, and other comparable quantities use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Executive Shell Rule
rules.body: Preserve the 280px institutional navigation anchor on wide screens and the continuous summary rail before introducing page-specific composition.

rules.name: The Flat by Default Rule
rules.body: Resting analytical surfaces are separated by tone and border; shadow is reserved for focus, stickiness, or direct manipulation.

rules.name: The Soft Precision Rule
rules.body: Radius communicates scale: controls stay compact, panels soften slightly, and only semantic tags or circular controls become fully rounded.

rules.name: The One Record Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Table links, mobile cards, and municipal map results all resolve to the same document-like technical sheet.

dos: Do use borders and cool tonal shifts before adding shadow.
Do keep cyan scarce and functional: actions, active states, focus, and meaningful data emphasis.
Do preserve the facility-type color and geometry mapping across badges, charts, legends, and map markers.
Do use tabular numerals for counts, beds, currency, and aligned comparisons.
Do keep the technical sheet legible as a stacked mobile view and as an A4 print document.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a field of disconnected floating cards.
Don't use facility classification colors as general decoration or status colors.
Don't add ambient shadows to resting panels, tables, or filter groups.
Don't hide source gaps or imply exact map coordinates where only municipality-level placement exists.
Don't preserve the wide desktop table on mobile; use the implemented record-card transformation.
